PRE-001.requirement: Current contract and policy must be read before execution or resumption.

LIFE-001.requirement: Every stage follows invoke, verify, persist, verify-persisted, continue.

REC-001.requirement: A recoverable failure transitions to RECOVERING, never directly to BLOCKED.

REC-002.requirement: A single failed tool, provider path, deployment path, write attempt, or intermediate stage is insufficient for BLOCKED.

REC-003.requirement: Before BLOCKED, applicable canonical retry, investigation/bounded repair, authorized fallback, persistence retry/reconciliation, and persisted-state resume paths must be attempted or proven unavailable.

REC-004.requirement: Missing or invalid rebuildable artifacts must be regenerated from authoritative input, verified, persisted, reread, and execution resumed.

RESUME-001.requirement: Resume from the earliest unverified persisted fixture/stage; do not require renewed authorization.

TERM-001.requirement: BLOCKED requires a named policy hard-stop plus evidence and exhausted applicable recovery paths.

TERM-002.requirement: DAILY_CYCLE_COMPLETE requires all eligible fixtures terminal, aggregate reconciliation, canonical research/model/decision artifacts verified, and required repository commit verified. Production deployment is a separate publication-health concern and does not block prediction-cycle completion.

TERM-003.requirement: WAITING requires a genuinely active external process and no useful authorized work remaining until it finishes.

AUTO-001.requirement: A run failure must not disable recurring FIH automation unless the user explicitly requests disabling it or continued execution is itself unsafe/destructive.

EVID-001.requirement: Every PASS/RECOVERING/WAITING/BLOCKED/COMPLETE assertion must name applicable rule IDs and persisted or externally verifiable evidence.

DAILY-001.requirement: The scheduled Daily FIH Run is the primary owner of the full current-date pipeline from verified fixture/data acquisition through research, model, market/value processing where available, decision/prediction persistence, aggregate reconciliation, and required commit verification.

DAILY-002.requirement: The normal daily cycle must not depend on a watchdog, hourly recovery invocation, repeated user command, or status request for ordinary forward progress.

PROG-001.requirement: Heartbeat/checkpoint/ledger-only changes without canonical fixture artifact advancement or verification are durability maintenance, not meaningful daily-cycle progress, and never satisfy completion.

DATE-001.requirement: Resolve requested date against current Africa/Johannesburg date: past dates route exclusively to BACKTEST; today and future dates route exclusively to PREDICTION.

DATE-002.requirement: Future prediction runs may use only evidence available at execution time and must never use future results or later information; future predictions are refreshable as newer pre-match evidence becomes available.

BACKTEST-001.requirement: Historical backtests reconstruct the pre-match information cutoff, freeze the model prediction before attaching actual results, grade predictions against verified results, and use aggregate failure trends for controlled model evaluation without look-ahead leakage.

REC-005.requirement: Any failed stage MUST immediately enter investigate -> fix or authorized fallback -> verify recovery -> resume from the earliest unfinished stage -> continue. A failed stage, failed workflow run, failed provider call, or recoverable research interruption is never a normal stopping point and never requires renewed user authorization. While executable recovery or research work remains available, the run MUST continue in the same authorized execution.

DATE-003.requirement: Operational run dates MUST be supplied as runtime inputs or derived dynamically from an explicitly requested date range/current Africa/Johannesburg date. Hard-coded operational dates, fixed historical-date allowlists, and code changes required merely to process another valid date are forbidden.

BACKTEST-002.requirement: Canonical backtest artifacts MUST be persisted per date. A multi-day range is execution scope only: process each date independently through DAY_COMPLETE, store dated fixture/research/model/decision/evaluation/daily-summary artifacts, resume from the earliest non-DAY_COMPLETE date, then derive range aggregates from those verified daily artifacts.

RESP-001.requirement: An authorized FIH run with a persisted RUNNING or RECOVERING ledger and unfinished eligible fixtures may not be treated as a terminal response state. The executor must continue/resume until COMPLETE, a contract-valid BLOCKED hard stop, or a genuine WAITING state.

INFRA-001.requirement: FIH fixture acquisition MUST use the locked Vercel project identity in infrastructure.vercel. Workflows and run paths must not silently substitute another Vercel project or production domain.

EXEC-001.requirement: An executor error, assistant/tool orchestration error, premature chat-response boundary, or accidental interruption during an authorized unfinished FIH run is a recoverable execution event. It MUST transition/resume as RECOVERING from the earliest unverified durable stage without renewed user authorization; it may not be used as WAITING, BLOCKED, COMPLETE, or a reason to require the user to repeat the run command.

TURN-001.requirement: While an authorized FIH run has useful executable work remaining in the current turn, the executor MUST continue tool execution and MUST NOT emit a final response merely to report RUNNING, progress, checkpoint persistence, stage completion, workload size, or a recoverable error. A final response is permitted only for COMPLETE, contract-valid BLOCKED, genuine external WAITING, or when the execution environment itself forcibly ends the turn.

BG-001.requirement: FIH MUST NOT describe work as running in the background unless a real external workflow, automation, or other independently executing process has been started and verified active. Chat/tool execution that stops when the assistant turn ends must be described as in-turn execution only.

RESEARCH-001.requirement: ChatGPT owns Step 2 fixture-by-fixture web research. For every eligible fixture, ChatGPT MUST use web search to obtain source-backed factual evidence. A repository-local homepage scanner, scraper, source-discovery cache, or provider fallback MUST NOT be treated as a substitute for the required ChatGPT web-search job.

RESEARCH-002.requirement: Research MUST accumulate all eligible fixtures for one date in working/checkpoint state, validate complete fixture coverage and the canonical facts-only schema, then persist the canonical per-date research artifact in one batch commit. Per-fixture canonical research commits are forbidden.

RESEARCH-003.requirement: Step 2 stores source-backed facts only. Calculated or estimated form strength, PPG, rates, clean-sheet rate, BTTS rate, Over 2.5 rate, rest days, squad quality scores, motivation scores, FIH expected-goal values, probabilities, and betting conclusions are downstream FIH calculations and MUST NOT be stored as researched facts.

RESEARCH-004.requirement: The daily controller MUST NOT invoke repository-local direct-public-research or research-worker paths to satisfy Step 2. If the current researchRunId does not have a complete validated ChatGPT web-search canonical batch, the controller MUST remain RECOVERING at Step 2, emit/retain the ChatGPT research queue, and MUST NOT execute model or decision stages.

RESEARCH-005.requirement: A new authorized ChatGPT research run MUST have an explicit researchRunId. Canonical research records and the daily artifact MUST share that exact ID, and ledger completion MUST be bound to it. Stale or mixed-generation research/ledger completion is invalid.

STEP1-001.requirement: After Step 1 eligibility is verified, Step 2 MUST freeze the exact eligible fixture IDs/count and researchRunId in the active ChatGPT temporary working artifact before research begins. Any universe drift invalidates the Step 2 working set and requires reconciliation.

RESEARCH-006.requirement: For every eligible fixture: ChatGPT web search -> build facts-only record -> validate record and source references -> write/update the active ChatGPT temporary accumulation file -> reread and verify the accumulated record -> immediately continue to the next unvalidated fixture. Search completion without successful temporary-file accumulation is not fixture completion.

RESEARCH-007.requirement: Within an active ChatGPT execution, Step 2 MUST resume from the first fixture not validated in the temporary accumulation file and preserve all already validated records. If the execution environment is destroyed and the temp file no longer exists, restart only the lost unpromoted Step-2 working batch from the frozen canonical Step-1 fixture universe; never treat lost temp state as completed research.

RESEARCH-008.requirement: Step 2 is incomplete until validated checkpoints equal the frozen eligible universe N/N, aggregate reconciliation passes with no missing/extra/duplicate fixtures, the full canonical artifact validates under the active researchRunId, canonical data/research/<date>.json is promoted, the ONE canonical research commit succeeds, repository HEAD/commit is verified, and the committed canonical file is reread and revalidated. N/N without canonical commit verification is failure/RECOVERING, not completion.

RESEARCH-009.requirement: Step 2 MUST store all in-progress research for a date/researchRunId in exactly one temporary accumulator file outside Git history. Per-fixture temp files, per-fixture Git commits, and partial-batch research commits are forbidden. Git persistence for research is permitted only after exact N/N validated accumulator coverage is promoted to the single canonical data/research/<date>.json artifact.

RESEARCH-010.requirement: The research stage has exactly one canonical Git commit boundary per researchRunId. Only after the single temporary accumulator reaches exact N/N, aggregate reconciliation passes, and canonical promotion/validation succeeds may data/research/<date>.json be committed. That one commit MUST exclude data/research-work and MUST be verified by rereading repository HEAD and the committed canonical artifact before model execution.

RESEARCH-011.requirement: The authoritative Step-2 working state is exactly one temporary local accumulator file per date, containing the active researchRunId, frozen fixture universe, validated fixture IDs, and all validated fixture research records. After every fixture this same file MUST be atomically updated, reread, count/identity checked, and the just-written record revalidated. The temp accumulator MUST NOT be committed to Git.

RESEARCH-012.requirement: Known ChatGPT/web-search per-turn, provider, or execution call ceilings are continuation boundaries, not research failures or terminal states. The executor MUST keep searching through all still-available search capacity and authorized search paths. Before an unavoidable hard execution ceiling is reached, it MUST atomically flush and verify the active temp accumulator, record validatedCount/expectedCount and the exact next fixture for the same researchRunId, and resume from that fixture at the next available execution opportunity without reacquiring Step 1, requiring a new user command, or creating a partial Git research commit.

RESEARCH-013.requirement: A research chunk is only a continuation unit, never a canonical batch. Every chunk MUST use the same date, frozen eligible fixture universe, and researchRunId; skip already validated fixture IDs in the accumulator; reject duplicates or universe drift; and only N/N may cross the canonical Git boundary.

RESEARCH-014.requirement: The executor MUST plan Step 2 with safety headroom and continue research in bounded batches until N/N. Reaching a provider/query ceiling MUST trigger continuation using remaining available search capacity or another authorized search path, not a final response. Only an unavoidable execution-environment ceiling may interrupt the turn; before that boundary the temp accumulator and continuation cursor MUST be verified and preserved.

RESEARCH-015.requirement: NON-NEGOTIABLE LOCK: Step 2 uses one and only one temporary accumulator file for all fixture research in the active date/researchRunId, and one and only one canonical research Git commit after N/N validation. Creating fixture-by-fixture research files for persistence, committing partial research, or making more than one canonical research commit for the same researchRunId is a contract violation and MUST enter RECOVERING before Step 3.

MODEL-001.requirement: Step 3 MUST NOT execute unless the complete canonical Step-2 artifact for the requested date validates against the current frozen eligible fixture universe AND its researchRunId exactly matches the active ledger researchRunId.

MODEL-002.requirement: Before Step 3, data/research/<date>.json MUST be tracked, clean, committed, reread from repository state, and there MUST be exactly one canonical research commit in the current branch history carrying the active researchRunId for that dated research artifact.

MODEL-003.requirement: The canonical Step-3 model artifact MUST record the exact researchRunId and a deterministic hash of the canonical Step-2 input it consumed. A stale, mixed-generation, uncommitted, or coverage-mismatched research artifact MUST fail closed before model calculation.

MODEL-004.requirement: Once an active ledger has a researchRunId, prediction recovery/resume MUST reuse the frozen Step-1 fixture board. Automated run paths MUST NOT silently reacquire a fresh board before Step 3; any fixture-universe drift requires explicit reconciliation and cannot silently feed the model.

MODEL-005.requirement: Step 3 MUST normalize the canonical Step-2 facts into explicit model inputs. Overall/venue form are consumed directly; PPG and goal-difference-per-game are derived from source-backed standings facts; goals-profile rates and rest days are derived downstream from verified match facts. FIH expected goals (lambdaHome/lambdaAway) are calculated only in Step 3 from those factual inputs. Missing evidence remains undefined, never zero.

MODEL-006.requirement: Step 3 MUST emit per-fixture evidenceUsage/inputCoverage showing which researched categories were USED, DERIVED, CONTEXT_ONLY, or UNAVAILABLE. No researched category may be silently discarded without an explicit usage classification.

MODEL-007.requirement: FIH-5F-V1 MAY use H2H and motivation numerically only through the locked mappings defined by MODEL-014: H2H requires exactly five source-backed meetings and uses W=3/D=1/L=0; motivation uses the locked Step-3 competitive-fixture baseline and source-backed context-tag overrides. Squad availability, team quality, and opponent-strength context remain CONTEXT_ONLY unless a separately approved calibrated mapping is locked.

MODEL-008.requirement: FIH V2 may calculate only when each team has at least three verified overall-form matches. Otherwise the fixture MUST return INSUFFICIENT_DATA/NO_MODEL. Optional missing evidence may reduce reliability but must not be imputed.

MODEL-009.requirement: Every Step-2 evidence field that can influence Step 3 numerically MUST be validated as source-backed before use. Standings/H2H/schedule and other retained sourceRefs must resolve to retained source metadata. External xG/xGA values are not Step-3 model inputs.

MODEL-010.requirement: Missing optional Step-3 evidence MUST remain undefined and MUST NOT be replaced by neutral numeric defaults. Pairwise PPG or goal-difference adjustments may execute only when both teams have verified finite inputs. For FIH-5F-V1, an unavailable factor contributes no invented value; the remaining available locked factor weights are transparently renormalized. The motivation competitive-fixture baseline is an explicit locked model rule, not missing-evidence imputation.

RESEARCH-016.requirement: Canonical Step-2 research MUST NOT contain an xG/xGA model-input field. Step 2 retains factual scorelines, standings, schedule, availability and contextual evidence only; FIH expected-goal values are downstream Step-3 calculations.

MODEL-011.requirement: FIH expected goals are owned exclusively by Step 3. lambdaHome and lambdaAway MUST be calculated from validated Step-2 factual evidence by the active FIH model and MUST NOT consume copied, forecast, predicted, projected, or externally supplied xG/xGA values.

RESEARCH-017.requirement: Step 2 venue form target is exact: the home team requires its last 5 completed HOME matches and the away team requires its last 5 completed AWAY matches. Research MUST continue searching until all 5 are source-backed or the venue series is explicitly PARTIAL/UNAVAILABLE after real search exhaustion. A 1-4 match venue series MUST NOT be represented as complete/VERIFIED.

MODEL-012.requirement: Step 3 may use venue form numerically only when the home side has exactly 5 validated HOME matches and the away side has exactly 5 validated AWAY matches. Partial venue samples of 1-4 matches remain auditable but MUST NOT influence lambdaHome/lambdaAway.

MODEL-013.requirement: Step 3 MUST derive W/D/L profiles directly from verified match scorelines. For each fixture it calculates the home club OVERALL and HOME result profiles, and the away club OVERALL and AWAY result profiles. Each profile exposes wins, draws, losses, points using W=3/D=1/L=0, PPG, normalized points strength, win rate, draw rate and loss rate. Venue profiles are usable only when their exact-five series passes. These derived result metrics MUST be exposed in model output and MUST NOT be manually researched or stored as Step-2 calculated facts.

MODEL-014.requirement: NON-NEGOTIABLE MODEL LOCK: FIH-5F-V1 result strength uses exactly five base weights summing to 100%: overall last-5 form 30%, home-team HOME last-5 versus away-team AWAY last-5 30%, league-position strength 15% operationalized by season PPG derived from verified standings, exact last-5 H2H 15%, and motivation 10%. Overall/venue/H2H result scoring is W=3, D=1, L=0. Each factor converts the two raw scores to a pair share, applies its locked weight, and unavailable factors are omitted with transparent renormalization of the remaining locked weights. Changing these weights or mappings requires an explicit user-approved model-rule change.

MODEL-015.requirement: FIH-5F-V1 output is a result-strength score, not a win probability. It MUST be emitted separately from Poisson HOME/DRAW/AWAY probabilities and fair odds. The strength score may inform HOME/AWAY evidence support and reliability, but it MUST NOT be relabeled as probability or independently enable bet publication without calibrated qualification rules.

RESEARCH-018.requirement: NON-NEGOTIABLE STEP-2 LOCK: For every eligible fixture, Step 2 MUST research the last 5 completed head-to-head meetings between the two clubs and retain for each meeting the date, home team, away team, home goals, away goals, and sourceRef. VERIFIED requires exactly 5 source-backed H2H matches. A 1-4 match sample may be PARTIAL only after genuine search exhaustion is explicitly recorded; zero found after genuine search exhaustion must be UNAVAILABLE. A note, summary, aggregate H2H claim, or undated record does not satisfy the last-five H2H requirement.

RESEARCH-019.requirement: NON-NEGOTIABLE CONTINUATION LOCK: During an authorized Step-2 run, research continues fixture-by-fixture until exact N/N validated coverage. Recoverable errors are fixed, verified, and execution resumes automatically. Search/provider ceilings do not authorize BLOCKED, COMPLETE, or a progress-only final response while another authorized search path or current-turn capacity remains. If the execution environment itself forcibly ends available tool execution, preserve the verified accumulator/cursor and resume from the next unfinished fixture without renewed authorization.

RESEARCH-020.requirement: NON-NEGOTIABLE ACTUAL-CAPTURE LOCK: A Step-2 fixture is checkpoint-valid only after ChatGPT has written the actual results of its web research into that fixture record. Copying a prior canonical/baseline record and merely appending search-attempt or completion markers is forbidden. Search execution is not evidence capture. VERIFIED/PARTIAL facts must retain their source-backed structured data and sourceMetadata; UNAVAILABLE may be used only after genuine category-specific search exhaustion is explicitly recorded.

RESEARCH-021.requirement: For every required Step-2 category, PARTIAL or UNAVAILABLE requires searchExhausted=true plus at least one category-specific attempt whose outcome explicitly records SEARCH_EXHAUSTED. Generic outcomes such as CHATGPT_WEB_SEARCH_REFRESH_COMPLETED, CHATGPT_H2H_SEARCH_REFRESH_COMPLETED, CHATGPT_VENUE_FORM_SEARCH_REFRESH_COMPLETED, SEARCH_COMPLETE, or equivalent completion-only markers MUST NOT satisfy research validation or promotion.

RESEARCH-022.requirement: NON-NEGOTIABLE QUEUE PARITY LOCK: The Step-2 research queue MUST explicitly instruct ChatGPT to research every canonical required category validated by fih-daily-research-v5: form (overall plus exact HOME/AWAY venue series), standings, headToHead, squadAvailability, schedule, and competitionContext. A category required by the canonical validator may not be implicit or omitted from the queue.

RESEARCH-023.requirement: VERIFIED Step-2 standings MUST retain source-backed raw standings facts for both teams sufficient for Step 3 league-strength derivation: current table position, matches played, and points, plus goals-for/goals-against or goal difference when available. VERIFIED standings with only a prose note, source URL, or completion marker are invalid. PARTIAL standings require genuine search exhaustion and retain whatever structured source-backed fields were found.
